nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances, written by transfer/transferFrom and initialised in the PORNCASH constructor.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of allowances, written by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Total token supply (10^28 base units) set once in the PORNCASH constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token decimals (18) set in the constructor.
SafeMath addition with overflow require; used by transfer and transferFrom for credit side.
SafeMath subtraction requiring b <= a; used by transfer and transferFrom for debit side.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow require; not referenced by the token logic.
SafeMath division requiring non-zero divisor; not referenced by the token logic.
Owned constructor that sets owner = msg.sender, i.e. untrusted caller becomes owner.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending newOwner address (no zero-address or renounce guard).
Two-step ownership acceptance requiring msg.sender == newOwner, then resets newOwner.
Token constructor: sets metadata, mints full supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; constant view over supply state.
Returns balances[tokenOwner] for an arbitrary address argument.
Moves tokens from balances[msg.sender] to balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd; no zero-address check.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens (classic approve race, no return-value check needed).
Debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to]; no approval-existence check.
Reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] for arbitrary addresses.
Sets allowance then performs an external call to the spender contract via receiveApproval.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting raw ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an external call to an arbitrary token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, balance debits, allowance writes and access checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to attacker-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
New owner address argument of transferOwnership.
Recipient address argument of transfer.
Amount argument of transfer, passed to safeSub/safeAdd.
Spender address argument of approve, used as the allowance mapping key.
Allowance amount argument of approve.
Debit source address argument of transferFrom.
Credit destination address argument of transferFrom.
Amount argument of transferFrom, passed to safeSub/safeAdd.
Owner address argument of allowance query.
Spender address argument of allowance query.
Spender contract address argument of approveAndCall, target of the external call.
Allowance/token amount argument forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded to the spender's receiveApproval.
Arbitrary token contract address argument, target of the external call.
Token amount argument forwarded to the external transfer call.
Local result variable c = a + b in safeAdd.
Local result variable c = a - b in safeSub.

Local result variable c = a / b in safeDiv.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner directly from msg.sender, so the untrusted caller becomes the privileged owner.
msg.sender is the sole input consumed by the Owned constructor.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, i.e. require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before promoting the pending owner.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into the privileged newOwner slot.
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner and clears newOwner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer with msg.sender as sender.
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] through safeSub/safeAdd.
The recipient parameter to is used as the credit key in transfer without any validation.
User-supplied tokens amount flows into safeSub for the debit side of transfer.
User-supplied tokens amount flows into safeAdd for the credit side of transfer.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], so the caller controls its own allowance slot.
approve stores the allowance in the nested allowed mapping.
The spender parameter becomes the inner key of the allowed mapping.
The tokens parameter becomes the stored allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to] via SafeMath.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] using safeSub.
transferFrom keys the allowance deduction on the untrusted msg.sender as spender.
The from parameter is an unvalidated source key for the balance debit.
The to parameter is an unvalidated destination key for the balance credit.
User-supplied tokens amount flows into safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
allowance simply reads the allowed mapping for the supplied addresses.
approveAndCall first writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before calling out.
approveAndCall unconditionally transfers control to the spender contract via the external receiveApproval call.
The external receiveApproval callback executes while the allowance state has just been mutated by the caller, allowing reentrant state manipulation.
The attacker-controlled spender address is the callee of the external call.
The tokens amount is forwarded into the untrusted external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary user-supplied bytes data is forwarded to the untrusted callee.
approveAndCall approves tokens on behalf of msg.sender and passes msg.sender to the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract supplied by the owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected only by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
The external call sends the rescued tokens to the privileged owner address.
The caller-supplied tokenAddress is the target of the external transfer call.
The tokens amount argument is forwarded to the external transfer call.
The payable fallback receives control from any untrusted sender and immediately reverts.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the supplied address.
The PORNCASH constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed maximum supply.
The constructor pre-assigns the entire supply to a hard-coded address in balances.
The local result c in safeAdd is the overflow-checked sum returned to transfer/transferFrom.
The local result c in safeSub is the underflow-checked difference used for debits.
The local result c in safeMul is the overflow-checked product.
The local result c in safeDiv is the division result guarded by a non-zero divisor require.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable without validation.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer key used by the allowance query.
The spender parameter is the inner key used by the allowance query.
